method: Interactive checks in real browsers against local server and real cached models; no browser adapters or mocked inference.

browsers.Chrome: Final upload, correction, invalid WAV, recovery, and physical microphone checks
browsers.Codex in-app browser: Upload and transcript correction checks; microphone permission flow was not completed

input.reference_transcript: Oh my God, he’s lost it. He’s totally lost it.

observed.transcript: I GHOT HE'S LOST THAT HE SOLLY LOST HIM

checks.name: physical_microphone_capture_and_stop
checks.observed: Recording timer advanced; Stop & analyze completed transcription, emotion, and reply; recording controls became usable again.
checks.limitation: No scripted phrase or reference transcript was used. This verifies device capture and the complete path, not transcription accuracy. Ambient audio and transcript were not saved.

checks.name: invalid_wav_clears_previous_prediction
checks.observed: cannot decode WAV audio; Needs attention; prior emotion, confidence, and reply absent; controls usable

checks.name: valid_upload_after_failure
checks.observed: New valid MELD upload returned sadness; transcript correction then returned sadness at displayed 50%.

fix_verified: Prior prediction and diagnostics are cleared on new input, reanalysis, recording, transcript edits, and errors.
scope: Functional smoke checks on one computer. No cross-browser compatibility or speech accuracy claim.
